planets.name: HAT-P-3 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Dombay with a 2.9-day year, found in 2007.

text.card: HAT-P-3 b was found in 2007 by HATNet as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Dombay. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname STASSUN_ET_AL__2017): disc_year 2007, disc_facility HATNet, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 2.89973815, pl_radj 0.94, pl_bmassj 0.65

quotes.title: HAT-P-3b
quotes.card: HAT-P-3b, also named Teberda, is an extrasolar planet that orbits the star HAT-P-3 approximately 450 light-years away in the constellation of Ursa Major.
quotes.introduction: It was discovered by the HATNet Project via the transit method and confirmed with Doppler spectroscopy, so both its mass and radius are known quite precisely.
